list_c_apis_from_headers: parse C header files and extract GPRAPI GRPCAPI CENSUSAPI function declarations with return types and arguments
headers_under_directory: recursively walk a directory tree and yield all header files matching the *.h glob pattern
mako_plugin_extract_apis: extract C API declarations from grpc and gpr library public headers and store them in a dictionary
review_list_c_apis: review the list_c_apis function to understand how it parses C API declarations from header file text
run_list_api_main: run the script to dump all C API declarations from include/grpc headers as YAML output
